source_title: Noah Wyle on the ‘Impressive’ Connection Real Healthcare Workers Feel to ‘The Pitt’ - People.com
source_excerpt:
The 2026 Sexiest Man Alive cover star tells PEOPLE how the show helps healthcare workers feel seen and how his FIGS partnership champions them
Noah Wyle says the drama helps healthcare workers explain their demanding jobs to loved ones
Feedback from medical professionals led the show to add respiratory therapists and nurse practitioners
The Pitt is set to return for its third season in January 2027
For Noah Wyle , one of the most rewarding parts of making The Pitt has been hearing directly from the real healthcare workers who see their own experiences reflected in the hit medical drama.
The 55-year-old Emmy-winning actor and 2026 Sexiest Man Alive cover star has heard from medical professionals who appreciate the show’s portrayal of their work, particularly because it helps their loved ones better understand what they experience on the job.
“They feel that it contextualizes the work they do to their families and partners who they can’t often articulate it to,” Wyle previously told PEOPLE . “I don’t want to articulate it, but they can nod their head when they say, ‘Is that what you do every day? Have you ever done that before? Have you ever seen that before?’”
That connection is especially meaningful to Wyle, whose work on The Pitt aims to capture not only the realities of working in an emergency department but also the dedication of the people who keep it running.
“I feel like that extra empathy it gives the support group around these workers is really invaluable,” he added.
And the feedback from those workers isn’t just making the ER alum proud. It’s also helping shape the show’s second and upcoming third seasons.
While the response to season 1 had been “mostly overwhelmingly positive,” the actor says healthcare professionals were quick to point out a few missing members of the medical team — and he took their feedback seriously. “The negative was that we didn’t have any respiratory therapists and we didn’t have any physical nurse practitioners, so we rectified that,” said Wyle in October 2025. “[There were] a lot of RTs and NPs in season two.”
Listening to those on the front lines is part of what makes the show’s commitment to authenticity so important to Wyle. And it’s a commitment that extends beyond the fictional halls of the Pittsburgh Trauma Medical Center.
The actor says told PEOPLE during his 2026 Sexiest Man Alive cover shoot that he constantly finds inspiration from the real-life doctors and healthcare professionals he’s encountered throughout his career and healthcare advocacy work.
“Oh yeah, tons. I work with a guy named Dr. Joe Sachs, who is about to receive a lifetime achievement award from Stanford Medical,” Wyle said. “Also through the company FIGS [where Wyle is a global brand ambassador] I’ve found very inspirational, really impressive people who are currently in the workforce. I find them incredibly noble.”
Wyle’s partnership with FIGS, the medical apparel brand best known for its scrubs, is another way he’s working to celebrate the healthcare workforce; he has joined the company in Washington, D.C. (alongside his mother Marjorie, a retired nurse) to advocate for mental health resources and better compensation for healthcare workers . The company also champions healthcare professionals through its Awesome Humans Foundation , which promotes and supports the people caring for others every day.

Last September, Wyle brought that mission to the Emmy Awards red carpet in a particularly stylish way. The actor wore a custom midnight-blue tuxedo created by FIGS , with fabric engineered to mimic the comfort of the medical scrubs he wears as Dr. Michael “Robby” Robinavitch on The Pitt .
The look even featured the words “Awesome Human” embroidered inside the collar, a nod to the brand’s slogan celebrating healthcare workers.
Wyle says the idea came to him spontaneously but ended up better than he could have expected. “We were in New York at the Gotham Awards and I was wearing a tuxedo and someone asked me if it was as comfortable as the scrubs I wear at work,” Wyle explained to Entertainment Tonight . “So I looked into the camera and I made a challenge to FIGS, ‘Hey FIGS, can you make me a tuxedo that’s as comfortable as the scrubs I wear?’ and they went and did it.”
He continued, “They put all their special touches all over it. I’m very proud to wear it.”
Wyle also used his Emmy acceptance speech to dedicate his win to medical staff working long shifts, and his advocacy for healthcare workers has continued alongside his work on The Pitt , including through the show’s efforts to portray sensitive medical experiences accurately.
Season 3 of The Pitt is scheduled to premiere in January 2027.
